battle.name: 薩拉熱窩以後
battle.brief: 薩拉熱窩之後，各國按動員表前進，歐洲在四十八日內變成全面戰爭。美國仍在門外，春田 M1903 還躺在軍械庫與菲律賓的營房裡；它要等到一九一七年才隨遠征軍上岸，在西線的壕溝線上以五發彈匣打出每分鐘十發的射速。

kit.name: 春田 M1903
kit.history: 美國一戰栓動步槍。遠征軍大量使用，班火力仍靠機槍。

countries: 一九一四年六月二十八日之後拉開的這場戰爭，前段是奧匈帝國與塞爾維亞王國之間的單獨交鋒：奧匈帝國於七月二十八日宣戰，維也納以皇帝 Franz Joseph 與陸軍總司令康拉德·馮·赫岑多夫為最高權力，實際作戰計畫由帝國參謀總部擬定，塞爾維亞則由貝爾格萊德的最高參謀部運作，國王尼古拉一世掛名總指揮，前線多由帕契奇與塞爾維亞邊境的三個軍區分擔。第二段是同盟與協約兩套體系把大國拖下水：德意志帝國以「空白支票」支持奧匈，帝國參謀總部依施里芬計畫令右翼越過比利時直取巴黎；俄羅斯帝國受與法國的協約牽制，沙皇尼古拉二世在七月三十日下令全面動員；法蘭西第三共和國由霞飛統一指揮，按計畫十七完成全國動員；大英帝國以閣僚會議加國防大臣基奇納的志願兵體制組建遠征軍。奧斯曼帝國在同年入戰，義大利到一九一五年才宣戰，美國則於一九一七年四月加入協約國，遠征軍由潘興統帶。各方的動員機制並不相同：德國有預先編好的鐵路運輸表與Aufmarsch計畫，俄國有按時刻表運轉的鐵路計畫，法國有計畫十七，英國有陸軍部署方案。這些表格決定了開戰最初幾週誰先把兵力擺到位置上。
countriesEn: The war that opened after 28 June 1914 began as a fight between two armies, Austria-Hungary and the Kingdom of Serbia: Austria-Hungary declared war on 28 July, with Emperor Franz Joseph and Army Chief of Staff Conrad von Hötzendorf as the supreme authority, the actual operational plans drawn up by the Imperial General Staff, while Serbia ran the war from the Belgrade General Staff, with King Nicholas I nominally in command and the front entrusted to Potić and to the three military districts along the Serbian frontier. The second phase pulled the great powers in through the alliance systems: Germany supported Austria-Hungary with a blank cheque and the Imperial General Staff, following the Schlieffen Plan, sent its right wing through Belgium toward Paris; Russia was bound by its entente with France, and Tsar Nicholas II ordered the general mobilization on 30 July; the French Third Republic mobilized under Joffre's unified command in accordance with Plan XVII; the British Empire built its Expeditionary Force from the Cabinet's mobilization and Kitchener's volunteer system. The Ottoman Empire entered during the same year, Italy declared war only in 1915, and the United States joined the Entente in April 1917 with an expeditionary force under Pershing. The mobilization machinery differed from side to side: Germany worked from prepared railway transport tables and the Aufmarsch plan, Russia from timetables laid on the railways, France from Plan XVII, Britain from a deployment scheme. Those tables decided which army got its troops into position first in the opening weeks.
people: 關鍵人物集中在六月末到七月末那二十多天裡。行刺者加夫里洛·普林西普是波斯尼亞的塞爾維亞族青年，二十歲不到，他在阿普爾碼頭附近以七點六五毫米手槍擊中弗朗茨·斐迪南大公及索菲亞王妃，同日早前 Nedeljko Čabrinović 與 Trifko Grabež 的兩次失敗暗殺已把警衛的部署打亂。奧匈方面，外交大臣貝希托爾德主張對塞爾維亞採取強硬，最終由政府拍板發出最後通牒；康拉德·馮·赫岑多夫力主打局部戰爭，七月十九日一度下令停止施里芬計畫的右翼攻勢，但取消令始終沒有真正傳到全軍。德國的關鍵人物是威廉二世、宰相貝特曼·霍爾韋格與參謀總長小毛奇；貝特曼在七月十五日備忘錄裡寫下開戰最為有利，威廉二世在七月初給奧匈的「空白支票」是整條連鎖反應的起點，而當時的參謀總長是法爾肯海因，他到八月二十四日才由小毛奇接任。俄國的沙皇尼古拉二世在七月三十日簽署全面動員令，等於把衝突推過了臨界點。法國的霞飛與福煦、英國的基奇納與約翰·弗蘭奇各自掌握本國的戰時機器；義大利在一九一五年由西諾尼主張開戰；美國的威爾遜在一九一七年因齊莫爾曼電報而改變中立立場，潘興同年六月率遠征軍抵達法國。就兵器而言，春田 M1903 的設計者是約翰·勃朗寧，一九〇三年他二十二歲就在斯普林菲爾德兵工廠交出這型步槍；一九一六年那批「更改型」的修正由查爾斯·諾曼·佛布斯主持，一九一八年改型則回應了戰時暴露的可靠性問題。
peopleEn: The decisive figures cluster into the twenty-odd days between the end of June and the end of July. Gavrilo Princip, a Bosnian Serb in his teens, shot Archduke Franz Ferdinand and the Duchess Sophie with a 7.65mm pistol near the Appel Quay on 28 June, after Nedeljko Čabrinović and Trifko Grabež had already made two failed attempts the same morning and disrupted the escort. On the Austro-Hungarian side Foreign Minister Leopold Berchtold pressed for firmness against Serbia and the government decided to send the ultimatum; Conrad von Hötzendorf favoured a local war and on 19 July countermanded the offensive wing of the Schlieffen Plan, but the order to stop never really reached the whole army. Germany's key men were the Kaiser, Chancellor Bethmann-Hollweg and Chief of Staff Moltke the Younger. Bethmann's note of 15 July argued that a war was the best way to settle matters, and the Kaiser's blank cheque to Vienna in early July started the chain; the General Staff was still run by Erich von Falkenhayn at that moment, and he was replaced by Moltke only on 24 August. In Russia Tsar Nicholas II signed the general mobilization order on 30 July, pushing the confrontation past the point of no return. In France Joffre and Foch, in Britain Kitchener and John French, each ran their own war machine; in Italy Sonnino argued for war in 1915; in the United States Wilson changed his posture of neutrality over the Zimmermann telegram in 1917, and Pershing brought the expeditionary force to France that June. On the weapons side, John Browning, still only twenty-two, delivered the M1903 Springfield's design in 1903 at the Springfield Armory; the 1916 redesign was directed by Charles Norman Forbes, and the 1918 redesign answered reliability problems that had shown up in the field.
kits: 本卡的春田 M1903（M1903 Springfield）在這場戰爭裡的位置，要從它尚未上場說起。一九〇三年由約翰·勃朗寧設計，一九〇四年起大量裝備美軍：.30-06 即七點六二乘五十四毫米凸緣彈，單排五發固定彈匣，槍管長七百六十二毫米，全槍長約一千零九十二毫米，連槍帶背帶重約四公斤，栓動式，槍機拉柄一體，後照門有五百五十米至八百米的階梯刻度，照門弦長約半米，常用有效射程約五百五十米，瞄準射速每分鐘八至十發，若以臥姿把槍豎在肩上射擊的「Dixie」操練可到每分鐘十五至二十發。一九一四年時它大部分在美國軍械庫、菲律賓與墨西哥邊疆，一九一六年國會批准擴產才真正鋪開；大戰期間美軍產量以百萬計，各種統計在一百四十萬至二百三十萬支之間，另向協約國輸送約二百萬支，一九三〇年代還有百萬支以上供二戰使用。同時真正支撐班火力的不是步槍而是機槍：配發的勃朗寧 M1911 機槍每分鐘約四百五十發，射速遠高於步槍；一九一八年美軍才裝備每分鐘五百至六百發的勃朗寧自動步槍，同時推出帶瞄準鏡的 M1903A4 狙擊型。關於這型槍還有一個流行說法要澄清：所謂「沉睡的春田槍」能一次打八發是假的，它只有五發彈匣，這個傳說多來自一九一八年一部好萊塢短片。
kitsEn: The position of the M1903 Springfield in this war has to be explained from the fact that it did not yet see the fighting. Designed by John Browning and issued in quantity to the US Army from 1904, it fired the .30-06, a 7.62x54mmR rimmed round, fed from a single row five-round internal box magazine, had a 762mm barrel, an overall length of about 1,092mm and weighed roughly four kilograms with sling. It was bolt-action with an integral bolt handle, a ladder rear sight graduated from 550 to 800 metres, a sight radius of half a metre, a practical effective range of some 550 metres, a rate of aimed fire of eight to ten rounds a minute, and up to fifteen to twenty a minute in the prone 'Dixie' drill with the rifle held vertically against the shoulder. In 1914 most of these rifles sat in American arsenals, in the Philippines and on the Mexican border; it was the 1916 appropriations that opened the floodgates of production, and during the war US output ran into the millions — estimates range from 1.4 to 2.3 million — with a further two million shipped to the Allies, and more than a million issued again in the 1930s for the Second World War. The real base of firepower, however, was the machine gun rather than the rifle: the Browning M1911 fired about 450 rounds a minute, and only in 1918 did the army adopt the Browning Automatic Rifle at some 500 to 600 rounds a minute, alongside the scoped M1903A4 sniper rifle. One popular claim about this rifle needs clearing up: the story of the 'Sleepy Springfield' firing eight rounds at a time is false. The magazine held five, and the legend largely grew out of a 1918 Hollywood short.
tactics: 作戰層面，這場戰爭的開端是兩套時間表的競賽。德軍右翼依施里芬計畫由萊茵河下游出發，越過中立的比利時，以每天數十公里的行軍速度直撲巴黎，沿途實施所謂「閃電突進」；法軍在邊境與阿登森林一線抵抗之後轉為北撤，兩軍在蒙斯、勒卡托、康布雷一帶相接，接著是「跑到海邊」的競逐——雙方都想先抵達英吉利海峽的港口，把對方逼到狹窄的突出部。到十一月底，戰線從瑞士邊界拉到北海，壕溝、鐵絲網與潛壕把運動戰鎖死，成為之後四年西線的樣子。德軍在舊武器和新武器之間取捨：加特林重機槍配備不足，機槍火力的提升靠的是德國改進的毛瑟M1916輕機槍與MG08/15，但前線補給因馬車運輸跟不上而崩潰。美國這一段是旁觀者的技術準備：一九一七年遠征軍在西線接手的是壕溝與據點的守備與有限進攻，步兵連以機槍組的射界與友軍支援火力壓制敵陣，攻勢時靠掩體、爆破與逐點躍進，突擊營制度與一營約一千一百人的戰鬥群編制都在此時成型；一九一八年美軍轉入進攻，默茲-阿爾貢一役投入逾百萬人。
tacticsEn: In operational terms, the war opened as a race between two timetables. The German right wing, following the Schlieffen Plan, set out from the lower Rhine, crossed neutral Belgium and marched on Paris at tens of kilometres a day in what contemporaries called the Schlieffen rush. After resisting at the Frontiers and in the Ardennes, the French turned north, and the two armies met around Mons, Le Cateau and Cambrai; from there came the race for the sea, with both sides trying to reach the Channel ports first and to pinch the other into a narrow salient. By the end of November the front ran from the Swiss border to the North Sea, and trenches, wire and dugouts locked the war into the stalemate that would dominate the Western Front for four years. Germany struggled with its mixture of old and new weapons: Gatling heavy machine guns were too few, machine-gun fire power was raised through the improved Maxim MG08/15, but supply collapsed because horse-drawn transport could not keep pace with the advance. For the United States this stretch was technical preparation as a bystander: in 1917 the expeditionary force took over trench and strongpoint sectors on the Western Front, company attacks were made with the bounding fire of the machine-gun group and friendly artillery, and advances relied on cover, demolition and bounding from cover to cover; the assault-battalion system and the combat team of about 1,100 men per battalion were shaped at this stage, and in 1918 the Americans went on the offensive, committing more than a million men in the Meuse-Argonne.
data: 可以核對的數字集中在幾處：暗殺發生於一九一四年六月二十八日上午，車隊在薩拉熱窩城內誤入拉蒂尼亞街後折返，行列停在阿普爾碼頭附近的街口，行程共走過約八公尺。奧匈的最後通牒於七月二十三日送出，塞爾維亞於七月二十五日答覆，奧匈於七月二十八日宣戰；俄國先局部動員，後於七月三十日全面動員；德國八月一日對俄宣戰、八月三日對法宣戰，八月四日因比利時中立遭破壞而與英國交戰。兵力上，德國一九一四年在西線投入約七十六個師，法軍約五十一個師，英國遠征軍首批為數個師、兵力約七萬人；德軍計畫要求在六週內解決法國，參謀總部的時間預算以數十日計。距離上，右翼自萊茵河畔推進至巴黎方向超過二百五十公里，自邊境戰到馬恩河不足三週。美國方面，一九一七年四月六日宣戰，一九一八年十一月在西線兵力逾二百萬，遠征軍在默茲-阿爾貢一役投入約一百二十萬人。全戰役各方軍人死傷合計逾二千萬人，死亡約九百萬至一千萬人，各家統計相差甚多。兵器數據方面：春田 M1903 口徑七點六二毫米、彈匣五發、槍管七百六十二毫米、全槍約一千零九十二毫米、重約四公斤、常規瞄準射速每分鐘八至十發。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked cluster in a few places. The assassination took place on the morning of 28 June 1914: the motorcade took a wrong turn into the Latin Bridge street and was made to return, and it stopped at a junction near the Appel Quay after covering some eight metres of ground. Austria-Hungary's ultimatum went out on 23 July, Serbia replied on 25 July, and Austria-Hungary declared war on 28 July; Russia mobilized in part and then generally on 30 July; Germany declared war on Russia on 1 August and on France on 3 August, and went to war with Britain on 4 August after the invasion of neutral Belgium. In men: Germany put about seventy-six divisions into the West in 1914 against about fifty-one French divisions, and the British Expeditionary Force began with several divisions and some seventy thousand men; the German plan demanded that France be beaten within six weeks, with the General Staff budgeting its time in tens of days. In distance: the right wing covered more than 250 kilometres from the Rhine toward Paris, and less than three weeks from the battles of the Frontiers to the Marne. On the American side: war was declared on 6 April 1917; American strength on the Western Front passed two million by November 1918, and more than 1.2 million were committed in the Meuse-Argonne. Across the whole war, military dead and wounded exceeded twenty million with deaths in the region of nine to ten million, estimates varying widely. As for the rifle itself: calibre 7.62mm, five-round magazine, 762mm barrel, overall length about 1,092mm, weight about four kilograms, normal aimed rate of fire eight to ten rounds a minute.
cause: 打起來的原因，要從一九一四年之前十年累積的結構說起。一九〇三年奧匈帝國吞併波斯尼亞與黑塞哥維那，製造了塞爾維亞民族主義者的一個積怨，此後塞爾維亞的軍力與塞爾維亞民族主義組織在俄法兩國的支援下迅速壯大；一九一二至一三年的巴爾幹戰爭削弱了奧斯曼帝國，也讓奧匈帝國把巴爾幹視為自身的戰略後院。真正點火的是暗殺本身與其後的外交 mishandling：德國在七月五日至六日給維也納「空白支票」，威廉二世在電報裡說這不是德國人民與塞爾維亞人民之間的戰爭，等於把奧匈的行動與德國的信用綁在一起；德國自身的計算則是，若俄國完成動員，兩面作戰的夢想就會破滅，因此寧可先打一次局部戰爭把俄國拖住。德國還有戰略層面的動機：施里芬計畫要求在俄國動員完成前解決法國，坦率地承認這是一場賭上歐洲秩序的賭博。俄國的動員表與一九一四年夏天在波蘭境內的大演習，恰好被德國解讀為進攻前奏；七月三十日全面動員令一旦簽下，德國便認定計畫已經啟動。與此同時，同盟與協約兩套承諾把四個大國綁在同一條連鎖上：德國支持奧匈，法國承諾俄國一旦開戰便不能袖手，協約國體系使任何一次局部衝突都可能擴散為全面戰爭；而六月與七月間的調停努力全部失敗，因為沒有一方願意在已經投入的信用上退讓。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting have to be traced through the structures accumulated in the decade before 1914. In 1903 Austria-Hungary annexed Bosnia and Herzegovina, creating a grievance among Serbian nationalists, and the strength of the Serbian army and of the nationalist organizations grew with Russian and French support; the Balkan Wars of 1912 and 1913 weakened the Ottoman Empire and made the Balkans look to Vienna like its own strategic backyard. What actually lit the fuse was the assassination and the diplomatic mishandling that followed. Between 5 and 6 July Germany gave Vienna a blank cheque, the Kaiser writing in his telegram that this was not a war between the German and the Serbian people, and so Austria's action was bound to German credit. Germany's own calculation was that if Russia completed its mobilization the dream of a two-front war would collapse, so it preferred a local war to hold Russia first. There were strategic motives too: the Schlieffen Plan required France to be beaten before Russia mobilized, and was candidly a gamble on the European order. The Russian railway timetables and the great manoeuvres in Poland in the summer of 1914 were read in Berlin as the prelude to an offensive, and once the general mobilization order was signed on 30 July Germany judged that the plan was already running. Meanwhile the alliance and entente commitments chained the four great powers together: Germany stood behind Austria-Hungary, France had promised Russia that it would not stand aside if war came, and the entente system made any local conflict liable to spread into a general war. All the mediation attempts of June and July failed, because none of the governments was willing to give back credit it had already spent.
impact: 影響至少落在四個層面。第一，歐洲的均勢與國際組織在一夜之間失效：四大帝國在戰後相繼崩解，德意志、奧匈、俄羅斯與奧斯曼的崩潰改寫了地圖與權力版圖，戰前的歐洲協調機制再也沒有恢復。第二，戰爭的性質改變了：一九一四年前的歐洲以短兵相接與騎兵機動為主，砲兵與重機槍尚未獨當一面；西線壕溝線拉開之後，交戰雙方轉入消耗與火力競賽，凡爾登與索姆河式的砲戰成為常態，戰爭成本與動員規模被推到工業社會的極限，總體戰的邏輯由此成形。第三，戰場擴成全球：加里波利、中東戰線與太平洋上的殖民戰役同時進行，日本在一九一四年趁機接收德國在中國的權利，中國自一九一四年起以勞工團形式參與歐洲戰事，約一萬四千名華工在法國與英國從事勞動；一九一七年的無限制潛艇戰把美國拖入戰爭，戰爭的規模與地理因此再無上限。第四，就本卡的兵器而言，春田 M1903 成了美國第一次以工業產能支援盟友的象徵：一九一四年它還在軍械庫裡，一九一七年之後成為遠征軍的標準步槍，二戰時期再供應百萬支以上，其後續的 M1918 改型把可靠性問題一次解決，射擊學校與民間把這型槍寫成美國工業的證明。
impactEn: The consequences worked on at least four levels. First, the European balance of power and its concert machinery collapsed overnight: four empires fell in turn after the war — German, Austro-Hungarian, Russian and Ottoman — rewriting both the map and the distribution of power, and the pre-war European system was never restored. Second, the nature of warfare changed: before 1914 European war had turned on close combat and cavalry manoeuvre, with artillery and heavy machine guns not yet decisive; once the trench line was drawn across the Western Front, both sides settled into a contest of attrition and firepower, the Verdun and Somme type of artillery duel became the norm, and the cost and scale of war were pushed to the limit of an industrial society, giving total war its logic. Third, the battlefield became global: Gallipoli, the campaigns in the Middle East and colonial fighting in the Pacific ran at the same time; Japan took over German rights in China as the war opened in 1914, and China took part in the European war from 1914 in the form of labour corps, with about fourteen thousand Chinese workers in France and Britain; the unrestricted submarine campaign of 1917 drew the United States in, and neither the scale nor the geography of the war had an upper limit any more. Fourth, for the rifle on this card, the M1903 Springfield became the symbol of America supplying its allies from industrial capacity in its first war: in 1914 it lay in arsenals, after 1917 it was the standard infantry arm of the expeditionary force, it was issued in millions again for the Second World War, and its M1918 redesign answered the reliability problems in a single stroke, while shooting schools and popular memory turned it into a proof of American industry.
result: 結果分三層看。第一層是開戰：奧匈帝國於七月二十八日對塞爾維亞宣戰，德國八月一日對俄、八月三日對法宣戰，八月四日進入比利時並與英國交戰，義大利到一九一五年才加入，羅馬尼亞一九一六年，美國一九一七年四月；施里芬計畫的右翼在渡過默茲河後因側翼暴露與兵力分散而停住，跑到海邊的競逐以陣線拉開告終。第二層是四年後的結局：同盟國在一九一八年的百日攻勢失敗，協約國推進至德國境內，同年十一月十一日德國接受停戰，四大帝國隨之瓦解，而美國以從債主變成最大債權國的姿態走上前台，新的國際秩序在一九一九年的凡爾賽條約裡被寫定。第三層回到兵器：一九一四年的春田 M1903 還在美國的軍械庫與菲律賓、墨西哥邊疆，一九一六年擴產、一九一七年出貨，才真正在歐洲戰場上大量消耗；一九一六年的「更改型」與一九一七年的生產批次在實戰中暴露出保險與機匣的問題，一九一八年的改型把五發彈匣的安全機關重新做過，這型槍隨後又在一九四〇年代出廠過百萬支以上，並在二戰後的朝鮮戰爭中作為後備武器延續使用。
resultEn: The outcome can be read on three levels. The first is how the war began: Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia on 28 July, Germany on Russia on 1 August and on France on 3 August, crossed into Belgium and went to war with Britain on 4 August; Italy came in during 1915, Romania in 1916, the United States in April 1917. The right wing of the Schlieffen Plan stopped after crossing the Meuse, its flank exposed and its forces scattered, and the race for the sea ended with the line drawn. The second level is where it finished four years later: the Central Powers' offensives failed in 1918, the Allies pushed into Germany, Germany accepted the armistice on 11 November, the four empires came apart, and the United States stepped forward as the principal creditor power, with the new international order written into the Treaty of Versailles in 1919. The third level returns to the rifle: in 1914 the M1903 Springfield was still in American arsenals and in the Philippines and on the Mexican border; it was only with the 1916 appropriations and the 1917 deliveries that it was actually consumed in quantity on European battlefields; the 1916 'Changes' and the 1917 production lots exposed problems with the safety and bolt in service, and the 1918 redesign reworked the safety mechanism of the five-round magazine, after which the type was produced in millions more in the 1940s and continued in reserve use in the Korean War.
